title: Jing Jing Lai Le Dao
synopsis:
Why is the evergreen bamboo, seemingly enjoying the melons on the wall, being constantly disturbed? Is the ferocious-looking serpent actually a 996 office worker? What kind of rigorous training will the shikigami undergo upon their first entry into the Heian-kyo battlefield? The first short-form animated series for the Onmyoji IP MOBA mobile game Onmyoji Arena has premiered, unfolding the strange and interesting events of the shikigami on the Heian-kyo battlefield!

(Source: Bilibili, translated)
